All saved! 🎉 Here's a summary of what I've remembered about your family:

| | Details |
|---|---|
| 👨 You | Type 2 diabetic — I'll keep meals **low GI, low sugar, low refined carbs** |
| 👩 Wife | Vegetarian — **no meat or fish**, eggs & dairy are fine |
| 👧👧 Twin Daughters | Love **chicken and eggs** |
| 🍛🥢 Cuisine Preference | **Indian and Chinese** |

---

A few things this means for your meal planning going forward:

- **For you:** I'll swap white rice for cauliflower rice or brown rice, use wholegrain options, and keep sauces light on sugar
- **For your wife:** I'll make sure every meal has a satisfying vegetarian version or is naturally vegetarian
- **For the girls:** Plenty of chicken dishes and egg-based meals they'll love
- **For everyone:** Lots of Indian and Chinese-inspired flavours! 🌶️

I'll apply all of this every time we plan meals together. Would you like me to now plan a **full week of meals** for your family using what's already in your fridge? 😊
